posts.title: Saltenna hires Dennis Defensor as Chief Executive Officer
posts.text: Saltenna announces the appointment of Dennis Defensor as Chief Executive Officer.

posts.title: Significantly enhanced range underground
posts.text: Saltenna has demonstrated significantly enhanced range over current wireless technology in solid underground facilities, tunnels, and through multiple levels of parking garages.

posts.title: Wireless along and through pressurized tanks and pipes
posts.text: In high-pressure, high-value IIoT networks, Saltenna has demonstrated wireless communications and sensing along and through pressurized tanks and pipes without drilling holes or running wires.
